old_caption: The video captures a young boy standing on a wooden dock by a calm body of water. He is shirtless, wearing patterned swim trunks, and barefoot. The boy begins by raising his arms out to the sides, then bringing them up above his head, and finally lowering them back down to his sides. His movements are fluid and rhythmic. The background features a serene landscape with trees and a clear sky. The water is still, reflecting the light. There are no other characters or animals visible. The camera remains stationary throughout the sequence.

The background features a serene landscape with trees and a clear sky, indicating a peaceful outdoor setting. The water is still, reflecting the light and adding to the tranquil atmosphere. caption: The video captures a shirtless boy in dark floral swim trunks standing barefoot on a rectangular black mat laid across a wooden dock over a calm lake. A tree-lined far shore stretches beneath a bright sky behind him. The boy stays planted with his legs and feet still, moving only his arms in a repeated swinging exercise. His hands begin near his chest, drop toward his hips, then sweep outward and upward until the arms extend to the sides. The elbows bend and the hands rise again, climbing past shoulder level toward his head and, on later cycles, fully overhead. As the arms lower they pass in front of the torso with visible motion blur before returning to the hips. This outward-and-upward sequence continues through the excerpt with a slight sway of the torso. The clip ends with the arms raised overhead, the motion still in progress.
